focus: D3 tick generation, nicening, auto-precision, SI formatting, color schemes, and d3-array citation location
noveltyJustification: The tagged d3-scale page and current D3 module pages support the behaviors; the GitHub d3-array fragment is replaced by the official per-function ticks page.
keyQuestions: Are the cited D3 APIs current?
Does the shipped corpus already cover the formatter and tick-loop gap?
answeredQuestions: d3-scale ticks, tickFormat, and nice retain the cited semantics in v4.0.2.
d3-array uses the 1/2/5 family and returns approximately count + 1 ticks; the correct citation is d3js.org/d3-array/ticks.
d3-format type s is an SI-prefix formatter.
d3-scale-chromatic provides sequential, diverging, and categorical schemes.
ruledOutDirections: Adding D3 as a runtime dependency is outside the single-file delivery contract and unnecessary after T2.
